notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (6)': Mindful Of The Future, Security Control, Tatooine: City Outskirts, Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard, Credits Will Do Fine and The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One; these count toward the 60. Two Effects start, so no single starting Effect is singled out.

The description calls it an 'Ep.1 THGG deck' and the strategy says it won the author's first tournament 'even though it was Ep.1' (Episode I-only environment, tournament unnamed, 2-0). The Coruscant-set printings are used for Tatooine, Sense, Alter and Control.
The Objective was posted across two lines ('The Hyperdrive Generators Gone/' / 'We Need A New One'); the stray second line was merged into the Objective.

Posted 'Tatooine Wattos Junkyard' dested the Light Coruscant site Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard (the draft had the Dark page); 'Yaura' dested Yarua; 'Panakas Blaster' dested Panaka's Blaster; 'Stay Here, Where Its Safe' dested Stay Here, Where It's Safe; 'A Tragedy Has Occured' dested A Tragedy Has Occurred. Mace Windu is the Coruscant card.
The post lists no Podracer and no Boonta Eve Podrace; the author races without starting it (as described in the strategy).
